name: AppDeploy
description:
AppDeploy lets you create and publish real web apps directly from a Claude conversation. Describe what you want, and AppDeploy turns it into a live public app.

Go far beyond static landing pages and websites. With AppDeploy, you can build and deploy dashboards, internal tools, collaborative workspaces, games, AI apps, and full web apps.

Built-in app features include:

- Hosting and public links
- User authentication and databases
- File uploads and storage
- Secure secrets management
- Real-time updates and notifications
- Custom domains
- AI capabilities and scheduled jobs

Ship and iterate with confidence. AppDeploy helps you test, improve, and republish your app with automated QA, visual bug reports, version history, source code access, and rollbacks.

Zero setup required. No Git, command line, IDE, hosting provider, or infrastructure setup. Just chat and publish.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AppDeploy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AppDeploy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api-v2.appdeploy.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AppDeploy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AppDeploy lists 21 MCP tools, including apply_app_version, configure_custom_domain, create_secret_entry, delete_app, delete_app_secrets, deploy_app, get_app_status, get_app_template, get_app_versions, get_appdeploy_sdk_reference, get_apps, and get_custom_domain_instructions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AppDeploy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AppDeploy in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AppDeploy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AppDeploy is developed by FreeBraavos LTD.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
